content_sections.heading: DIBD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DIBD Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DIBD Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DIBD Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Associate - Finance: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounts or equivalent with minimum 2 years experience; MBA (Finance)/CA/ICWA preferred. Assistant Manager-Finance: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounts or equivalent with minimum 3 years experience; MBA/PG Diploma in Finance/CA/ICWA preferred. General Knowledge: Knowledge of GFR, GST, TDS, ERP/Tally is preferred.

content_sections.heading: DIBD Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 58 years for all posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DIBD Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DIBD to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIBD Finance Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the DIBD Finance Positions is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted online before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Finance Positions at DIBD?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Finance Positions at the Digital India BHASHINI Division-DIC (DIBD). These include one Associate - Finance and one Assistant Manager-Finance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Associate - Finance post?
faq.answer: For the Associate - Finance position, a Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounts or equivalent with a minimum of 2 years of experience is required. An MBA (Finance), CA, or ICWA is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these DIBD recruitment posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Finance Positions at DIBD is 58 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the DIBD Finance Positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DIBD Finance Positions. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the DIBD Finance Positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DIBD Finance Positions will involve two stages: Screening of applications and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Finance Positions at DIBD are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for DIBD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of DIBD?
faq.answer: The official website of Digital India BHASHINI Division-DIC (DIBD) is https://bhashini.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply online.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any specific knowledge requirements for these finance roles?
faq.answer: Yes, in addition to the educational qualifications, knowledge of GFR (General Financial Rules), GST (Goods and Services Tax), TDS (Tax Deducted at Source), and ERP/Tally is preferred for these finance positions.
